source_profile:
Throughout the frontier — Commercial monopoly, local independence

Inciting event: Eastway Overland & Express receives a new royal concession permitting it to
construct additional toll roads, bridges, and waystations throughout the eastern marquisates.

The company begins restricting access to certain newly improved crossings and acquiring the
lands surrounding alternative routes.

Potential progression: Construction and land purchases → toll disputes → independent
carriers forced out of business → illegal bypass routes established → attacks against company
property → coordinated resistance to the Overland.

Unlike several of the other plots, this conflict need not have a singular villain. The Overland
genuinely makes frontier travel safer and more reliable, even as its growing influence threatens
the independence of the people it serves.

Established foundations: the commercial interdependence of the major enterprises and the
threat they pose to independent frontier businesses.
